answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 21063 Country: India Title: I am away from my wife means I am working in gulf. My question is can I talk related to sex on phone. Please guide me in this matter. Question: AssalamualaikumRBT, Respected mufti sahab I am away from my wife means I am working in gulf. My question is can I talk related to sex on phone. Please guide me in this matter. Allah hafiz. Answer ID: 21063 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 426/426/M=1431) There is no problem if you talk on phone in secrecy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
